chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Musa, from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Hamdani, from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Ja'far or Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) — the uncertainty being from Muhammad ibn Musa — he said:

The rue was mentioned, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, there are benefits in it — it increases the intellect and augments the brain, apart from the fact that it decays the water of the back.' And it is reported that it is good for earache.'
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits and side effects of the herb rue according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, the Imams (specifically identified as Abu Ja'far or Abu al-Hasan) elucidate the dual nature of rue (*al-sadab*), highlighting its cognitive benefits of increasing intellect and fortifying the brain, while cautioning against its tendency to corrupt the spinal fluid (*ma' al-zahr*). This reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of balancing therapeutic utility with physiological caution, noting its specific efficacy for ear ailments as a complementary benefit.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Muhammad Bin Musa, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Hamdany, from Muhammad Bin Amro Bin Ibrahim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> or Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> – the uncertainty being from Muhammad Bin Musa who said, ‘

The rue was mentioned, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But there are benefits therein – it increases the intellect, and augments the brain, apart from it that it decays the water of the back’. 
And it is reported that it is good for the ear ache’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Muhammad ibn Musa from Ali ibn al-Hassan al-Hamadaniy from Muhammad ibn ‘Amr ibn Ibrahim who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, or abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, -uncertainty is from Muhammad ibn Musa- has said,

‘Once al-Sadab was mentioned and He (the Imam) said, ‘There are benefits in it. It increases the power of understanding, increases in the brain except that it putrefies one’s back’s water.’ It is narrated that it is very good for ear ache.”
